audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially for 3D printing, CAD visualization, and lightweight 3D asset processing.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, COLLADA, and 3MF files via Scene.open() with automatic format detection from file extension or explicit FileFormat.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Exports scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression, coordinate system, and unit scaling.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build hierarchical scenes using Scene, Node, and Transform objects, supporting child node creation, entity assignment, and independent node transforms.
capabilities.title: Construct and traverse scene graphs

capabilities.text: Build meshes programmatically via Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon(), or convert primitives to meshes using to_mesh().
capabilities.title: Create and edit mesh geometry

capabilities.text: Assign LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure color and factor properties for diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness.
capabilities.title: Apply materials to geometry

capabilities.text: Construct animation clips using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence, and store skeletal bind-pose data with Pose and related types.
capabilities.title: Support keyframe animation

limitations.text: FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() and save_to_stream() raise NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError; image rendering is unsupported.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created, though material properties work without them.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError; CSG operations are not implemented.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation, modification, and export of 3D scenes using a pure-Python API without requiring external SDKs or native binaries.
Supports common 3D interchange formats (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF) for interoperability across design and manufacturing tools.
Provides a scene graph model with nodes, entities, transforms, and materials for structured 3D scene composition.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond those explicitly listed in format:input and format:output facts is unclear; some formats may be partially implemented but not tested.
Whether the experimental FBX importer works reliably with real-world FBX files is uncertain due to lack of integration tests with actual FBX fixtures.
The behavior of Scene.open() and Scene.save() when given streams without explicit FileFormat hints for formats other than STL and glTF is not fully documented in examples.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect geometry, nodes, and materials.

workflows.name: Export scenes to 3D formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, or 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression, coordinate system, and unit scaling.

workflows.name: Build meshes from control points
workflows.text: Construct custom meshes by adding control points and polygons, then attach them to scene nodes.

workflows.name: Create and modify primitives
workflows.text: Instantiate parameterized primitives like Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and convert them to editable meshes via to_mesh().

workflows.name: Assign materials to geometry
workflows.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygonal geometry
workflows.text: Triangulate arbitrary polygons using PolygonModifier.triangulate() for compatibility with formats requiring triangle-only meshes.
